config.label: Serve the clipboard read-only
config.description: Serve the clipboard read-only. When true, clipboard_write is not registered: it is absent from tools/list and uncallable, though still listed in a disabled state on the manifest and landing page. Accepts true/false/1/0/yes/no/on/off.
